lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: An ordered series of vertical columns containing high-luminance circular pixel clusters, with approximately 4 to 6 centroids per column in the mid-flank region, transitioning to a higher-density, less-ordered arrangement anterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal alignment of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of localized maxima across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature extending from the branchial region toward the posterior, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs within the visible area of the first dorsal fin, with higher spatial frequency observed toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, elongated cluster of low-intensity pixels is visible on the mid-lateral flank below the primary ridge, potentially indicating an attached ectoparasite or a localized surface mark.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a unique high-frequency patterning of small-diameter high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller than the primary flank constellation nodes.
